command: Create rtl/integration/hetero_l3_production_top.sv. Replace the old flop command_event_scoreboard path with command_event_frontend_sram; route runnable commands through the existing command_dispatch engine map 0 control, 1 DMA, 2 Matrix, 3 SFU, 4 KV, 5 collective; connect descriptor/control, weight DMA, activation/KV DMA and fallback as logical Shared-L2 read clients 0..3 of shared_l2_client_arbiter, and DMA/engine fallback as write clients 0..1. Instantiate matrix_direct_streams, gemmini_spad_tensor_gateway, aha_tensor_stream_endpoint and kv_tensor_stream_endpoint. Merge engine completions into the depth-16 completion FIFO, update the real event SRAM before releasing waits, and add a simulation-enabled watchdog that emits status 6 then locks new commands until reset.
success_condition: A combined deterministic regression accepts at least 100000 commands and mixed descriptor/DMA/stream operations with all four read clients, both write clients, six engine IDs and all four direct channels progressing; zero loss, duplication, reorder, starvation, assertion, macro error or timeout; event 0 and nonzero-status semantics hold; completion never precedes final source-side stream acceptance; reset epoch and watchdog lock behavior pass; strict Verilator -Wall is clean.
failure_policy: Do not use engine_contract_adapter as final Matrix/SFU/KV evidence, bypass command_event_frontend_sram or the real event macro, statically reserve a physical L2 read port, add a third read port, drop endpoint sideband, hide a timeout, weaken the 100000-command threshold, or mark L3 PASS from standalone subgates.
